messages:
Anika: Partner-APAC reported a ~30% throughput regression after we moved their marketplace image from ROCm 5.4 -> 5.6. They want guidance; could be kernel ABI or driver pin. Looping in infra + eng-ml. @Nina you on call with them?
Samir: Thanks. Can you paste the image tags and the minimal repro logs? We haven't validated 5.6 on our marketplace images yet.
Nina: They provided this: image: `redwood/llm-runtime:rocm-5.6-2026-03-15`, kernel: `6.5.12`, amdgpu: `6.0.0`. Repro command: `python serve_bench.py --batch 8 --seq 512`. No crashes, just lower throughput.
Lucas: Quick hypothesis — ROCm 5.6 adjusted prefetch/streaming heuristics; KV-cache eviction pattern might change latency/throughput at larger seqs. Also check if BLAS fell back to host.
Priya: Partner asked if we can roll the marketplace listing back to the 5.4 image while you triage. They prefer no app-level change.
Samir: @Priya we can publish a new marketplace image `rocm-5.4-stable` and update listing with a migration note. Need product signoff + run E2E smoke suite first.
infra-bot: CI failed on `runtime-integration (rocm-5.6)`: `tests/serve_perf.py::test_throughput` — 15% below baseline.
```
Throughput: 320 req/s (baseline 380)
Histogram: p50 45ms p95 210ms p99 420ms
Log excerpt: [worker0] kv_cache_eviction: evicted=24 reacquire=8
```
Anika: Ok action items: (1) Samir produce rollback image + smoke tests (2) Lucas run perf trace against partner repro (3) Samir/Lucas validate kernel/module diffs (4) Priya draft partner comms and ETA.
Lucas: Starting a short perf trace now. Will share flamegraph and a short diff. Cmd: `./perf-trace.sh --image redwood/llm-runtime:rocm-5.6-2026-03-15 --bench serve_bench.py` :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Samir: I'll run `modinfo amdgpu` on the partner node image and diff against our golden node. If we see ABI mismatch -> escalate to HW partner for a driver hotfix.
Nina: Partner is fine with a non-disruptive listing change for now, asking for ETA and whether this is safe for production in APAC.
Priya: Aiming for ~4h to produce rollback image + smoke results and a short FAQ for partners.
Anika: Thanks. If kernel ABI break is confirmed, @Samir escalate to vendor and request targeted hotfix; otherwise we ship the rollback and schedule a 24h canary before reverting the listing.
Samir: Noted. Marking P2 for now; will post a status update in 1h.
